title: 第十五章 全都对上了！
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
025被骂的狗血淋头，依然安静如鸡。

    萧姚烦躁地抓乱头发。

    【把截图发给我。】

    【然后滚去查清楚倒扣38天的原因。】

    025一言不发地传了高糊截图，然后光速撤退。

    屋里一片死寂，和煦的阳光仿佛被死死拦在墙外，照不进分毫。

    萧姚背靠着门，慢慢滑坐在地，抱紧双膝，牙齿死死咬住下唇。

    320天……硬生生少了38天……

    萧姚闭上眼，将后脑勺顶在屋门上。

    哭喊声、血红色交织在一起，冲撞撕扯着萧姚紧绷的神经，无力感和绝望像浓雾一般，将她吞没。

    萧季同沧桑的背影在眼前一闪而过，萧姚不甘地攥紧拳，咬牙睁开眼。

    还有时间，还有线索，她不能坐以待毙！

    萧姚捏捏酸胀的鼻梁，点开截图。

    画面中间是一面黑底红纹的幡旗，和反派手里的旗帜十分相似。

    萧姚将截图放大，试图从纹路上抠出点细节，结果只看到了双色马赛克，再没有别的线索。

    萧姚摩挲着下巴，陷入沉思。

    在灭门预告里，反派用她的小命逼迫她娘炼制幡旗，导致宗门为正道不容。

    如今，线索给出了这面旗帜，会不会是因为反派已经出手了呢？

    她娘最近忙着查案，会不会跟反派有关呢？

    她得去找萧季同打听打听。

    萧姚撑着身子站起来，理了理凌乱的头发，深吸一口气，推开门闷头出去，一头撞上一堵人墙。

    对方被撞得后退两步。

    萧姚抬眼一看。是苍岚。

    他的耳朵紧张地垂着，脸上浮现出淡淡的不安。

    “姐姐，您怎么突然……是苍岚做错了什么吗？”

    萧姚一手揉着鼻尖，一手从怀里摸出一枚玉笺。

    “没事，就是突然想起葛叔布置的课业还没完成。”

    “我现在去找他，省得他又迁怒你，我晚点回来。”

    苍岚乖巧地帮萧姚抚平衣摆的褶皱，安静地跟在她身后，一直把人送到洞府门口。

    “姐姐，苍岚在家等你。”

    萧姚闷头离开，背影越来越远，在即将踏上传送法阵之时，又折返回来。

    苍岚小跑着迎上去，疑惑地歪歪脑袋。

    “不是说想要一幅高大威武的画像吗？来，姐姐先满足你，再去找他们。”

    萧姚把画纸拍在墙上，毫无形象地趴在墙边，勾出一幅堪称抽象的简笔画。

    苍岚立在她身后，看得眼皮轻跳。
content_en:
025 was scolded bloody, but still as quiet as a chicken.

Xiao Yao scratched his hair irritably.

[Send me the screenshot.】

[Then go find out the reason for the 38-day deduction.】

025 sent a high-definition screenshot without saying a word, and then retreated at the speed of light.

There was a dead silence in the room, and the warm sunlight seemed to be blocked by the wall, unable to penetrate at all.

Xiao Yao leaned against the door and slowly slid to the ground, hugging his knees tightly and biting his lower lip with his teeth.

320 days... 38 days suddenly missing...

Xiao Yao closed his eyes and pressed the back of his head against the door.

Cries and blood-red intertwined, and the collision tore at Xiao Yao's tense nerves. The feeling of powerlessness and despair swallowed her up like a thick fog.

Xiao Jitong's vicissitudes of life flashed before his eyes. Xiao Yao reluctantly clenched his fists, gritted his teeth and opened his eyes.

There was still time and clues, she couldn't sit still and wait!

Xiao Yao pinched the bridge of his sore nose and clicked on the screenshot.

In the middle of the screen is a flag with red stripes on a black background, which is very similar to the flag in the hands of the villain.

Xiao Yao enlarged the screenshot and tried to dig out some details from the lines. In the end, he only saw a two-color mosaic and no other clues.

Xiao Yao rubbed his chin and fell into deep thought.

In the trailer for the annihilation of the family, the villain forced her mother to refine the flag at the cost of her own life, causing the sect to be incompetent for the right path.

Now, clues have given out this flag. Could it be because the villain has already taken action?

Her mother has been busy investigating the case recently, could it be related to the villain?

She had to go find Xiao Jitong to find out.

Xiao Yao stood up, straightened his messy hair, took a deep breath, opened the door and walked out, bumping into a wall of people.

The opponent was knocked back two steps.

Xiao Yao looked up.It's Cang Lan.

His ears drooped nervously, a slight look of uneasiness on his face.

"Sister, why are you suddenly...Did Cang Lan do something wrong?"

Xiao Yao rubbed the tip of his nose with one hand and took out a jade note from his arms.

"It's okay, I just suddenly remembered that I haven't finished the homework assigned by Uncle Ge."

"I'm going to find him now to prevent him from angering you again. I'll be back later."

Cang Lan obediently helped Xiao Yao smooth out the wrinkles on his clothes, and followed her quietly to the door of the cave.

"Sister, Cang Lan is waiting for you at home."

Xiao Yao left with a dull head, his back getting further and further away, and when he was about to step onto the teleportation circle, he turned back.

Cang Lan trotted up to meet him, tilting his head in confusion.

"Didn't you say that you want a tall and majestic portrait? Come, sister, I will satisfy you first, and then go find them."

Xiao Yao slapped the drawing paper on the wall, lay facelessly on the wall, and drew an abstract simple painting.

Cang Lan stood behind her, her eyelids twitching slightly.
